argv: import os,sys,psycopg; c=psycopg.connect(os.environ['DATABASE_URL'],connect_timeout=5); v=sorted((t, c.execute('select count(*)::text || chr(58) || md5(coalesce(string_agg(x::text, chr(10) order by x::text), chr(32))) from '+t+' x').fetchone()[0]) for t in sys.argv[2:]); c.close(); open(sys.argv[1],'w',encoding='utf-8').write(repr(v)); print('TRUOC', v)
